messages:
sam-partners: Spectral signed NDA and requested a short EAP for marketplace packaging. Need bench + telemetry outline this week. @rachel-spectral can you confirm dates?
rachel-spectral: We can host two nodes week of 06/08. Need CSV telemetry, anonymized hosts, and embargo on public numbers.
moss-eng: Proposed minimal fields: timestamp, token_ms, p95_ms, gpu_power_w, gpu_temp_c, mem_mb. Sample every 1s. We'll provide bench script and quickstart.
lia-legal: NDA OK. Retention 30 days default, need Spectral approval to extend. Will draft embargo clause.
ops-bot: Reservation: 2026-06-09 09:00-17:00 UTC, NodeA/NodeB reserved.
sam-partners: Action list: moss to post bench script, lia to send embargo + retention draft, rachel to confirm KMS for telemetry. Dry-run Fri 06/05 15:00 UTC.
rachel-spectral: Confirm KMS and S3 bucket. We'll rotate upload keys daily. No blockers on our side. :thumbsup:
sam-partners: Great, I'll update the tracker and close loop after dry-run.
